newsitem.title: USA: K.C.Power-Western Resources merger talks progress.
newsitem.headline: K.C.Power-Western Resources merger talks progress.

text.p: Kansas City Power & Light Co and Western Resources Inc said Thursday that substantive merger negotiations were continuing and Western had extended its takeover offer for K.C. Power.
Western Resources said it was extending the expiration date of its tender offer to 1700 EST on February 7, due to positive dialogue between the two companies and the complexity of negotiations.
In June, Western Resources increased its offer to $31 per share from $28 per share in Western stock for each share of Kansas Cit Power stock.
As of 1700 EST February 5, the companies said about 30.3 million shares of Kansas City Power, or about 49 percent of the total outstanding shares, had been tendered to Western.
